# ⚒️ ModernKit

**Bringing newer Minecraft items into older Minecraft versions.**

![ModernKit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GItUser1928307/modernkit-source-code/main/images/modernkit-modrinth-256.png)

Ever wanted to experience some of Minecraft's newer items without leaving your favorite older versions behind?

**ModernKit** aims to bridge that gap by introducing items and equipment inspired by newer Minecraft updates into older versions, bringing new possibilities to your gameplay.

Whether you're smashing enemies with a Mace, launching Wind Charges, charging into battle with a Spear, mining bedrock in survival, or equipping yourself with Emerald, Rainbow and Obsidian gear, ModernKit brings more tools and equipment to your Minecraft world.

---

## ✨ What's Included?

### ⚔️ Weapons & Combat

- **Mace** — Fall from a height and land a powerful smash attack. The longer the fall, the more damage you deal. A successful smash cancels your fall damage, knocks back nearby mobs, and plays impact effects — with its own custom sounds since v1.5.97: ground smashes (a heavier one on big falls) and air sounds for the Wind Burst launch.
- **Spears** — Six variants: wooden, stone, golden, iron, diamond, and netherite. Jab with a quick attack, or hold to charge into enemies. Includes first- and third-person animations — and its own sounds since v1.5.97: attack whooshes, hit impacts and the three lunge charge states (engaged, tired, disengaged).
- **Lunge Enchantment** — A spear-exclusive enchantment (levels I to III).
- **Mob Kabob Advancement** — Hit five mobs with a single charge attack.
- **Mace Enchantments** (new in v1.5.6) — The four modern mace enchantments, backported:
  - **Density** (I–V) — Adds 0.5 extra smash damage per block fallen per level. Found at the enchanting table; exclusive with Sharpness, Smite and Bane of Arthropods.
  - **Breach** (I–IV) — Mace hits make the target's armor 15% less effective per level, including natural mob armor, but never Protection enchants or the Resistance effect. Found at the enchanting table; exclusive with Sharpness, Smite and Bane of Arthropods.
  - **Wind Burst** (I–III) — A successful smash launches you back into the air (about 8 blocks per level), letting you chain smash attacks. The burst explosion also knocks back nearby mobs and presses buttons, levers, wooden doors and fence gates, rings bells and breaks chorus flowers, like a Wind Charge — and even mobs like pouncing foxes holding a Wind Burst mace can activate it. Blast Protection reduces the launch. Loot-only treasure enchantment, found in Bastion Treasure and End City chests.
  - **Swift Sneak** (I–III) — Sneaking speed becomes 30% + 15% of walking speed per level (75% at level III). Loot-only treasure enchantment, found in Stronghold Library and Simple Dungeon chests.

### 🌪️ Wind & Breeze Items

- **Wind Charge** — A throwable projectile that works like the real one from newer versions: free wind charge jumps (fall damage only builds up below the burst height), a ~7-block straight-up launch when it bursts at your feet, a swirling cloud flight trail, expanding gust-ring visuals, and its own custom sounds (custom bursts and a throw whoosh).
- **Breeze Rod** — Used to craft Wind Charges and the Mace, and to repair the Mace.
- **Heavy Core** — The crafting component at the heart of the Mace. A real placeable block, with the Heavy Core texture on all six faces (new in v1.5.82).

### ⛏️ Tools

- **Bedrock Pickaxe** — Mine bedrock in survival mode! Bedrock drops itself when mined.

### 💚 Emerald Equipment

A complete equipment collection crafted using Emeralds.

- **Emerald Sword** — An emerald-themed weapon.
- **Emerald Pickaxe** — An emerald-themed mining tool.
- **Emerald Axe** — An emerald-themed axe.
- **Emerald Shovel** — An emerald-themed digging tool.
- **Emerald Armor** — A complete armor set consisting of a Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots, with real 3D shaped pieces such as a helmet crest, cheek guards, shoulder pauldrons, knee plates, and boot cuffs.
- **Refined Armor Textures** — Updated in v1.5.2 with a cleaner, more polished appearance. The unwanted gold-colored top layer has been removed from the Emerald Armor textures.
- **Unified Colors** — Updated in v1.5.704: the Emerald Pickaxe now uses the same pure emerald green palette as the Emerald Axe and Shovel.
- Emerald equipment uses the same standard crafting shapes as Rainbow equipment, with Emeralds replacing Rainbow Ingots.

### 🌈 Rainbow Set

The most powerful gear in ModernKit, with animated rainbow icons.

- **Rainbow Sword** — Massive damage and a very fast attack speed.
- **Rainbow Pickaxe** — Breaks almost anything, obsidian included, nearly instantly.
- **Rainbow Axe** — A powerful rainbow-themed tool.
- **Rainbow Shovel** — A rainbow-themed digging tool.
- **Rainbow Armor** (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots) — Maximum protection and toughness, and full knockback immunity when you wear the whole set. New in v1.5.3: a full 3D armor model with a tall helmet crest, wing fins, shoulder spikes, forearm bracers, hip guards, ankle fins, and a chest gem.
- **Rainbow Ingot** — The crafting and repair material for the set.
- Every Rainbow item is fireproof, enchantable, and has enormous durability.

### 🪨 Obsidian Set (new in v1.5.9)

Dark purple equipment and building blocks crafted from Obsidian.

- **Obsidian Sword** — Hits for 13 damage.
- **Obsidian Pickaxe / Axe / Shovel** — 2048-durability tools, one step above Diamond.
- **Obsidian Armor** (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots) — Diamond-level protection with Netherite-level toughness, repairable with Obsidian. Has its own custom 3D model: a jagged helmet crest, swept-back horn spikes, cheek guards, layered chest plating with a chest gem shard, heavy pauldrons, a plated belt, and boot cuffs.
- **Obsidian Stairs / Slab / Door** — Obsidian building blocks. The door has window panes, opens by hand, and zombies can't break it down.
- Every Obsidian item is fireproof like the obsidian block — dropped items don't burn in fire or lava (new in v1.5.97).

### 🧱 Building Blocks (new in v1.5.9)

- **Rainbow Block / Slab / Door** — the rainbow gear's animated shimmer as placeable blocks; the rainbow layers animate in your hand, in your inventory and when placed.
- **Gold / Diamond / Emerald / Coal / Redstone Slab** — half-size versions of the vanilla blocks. The Redstone Slab works like a full block for redstone: dust can be placed on it, dust climbs onto it, and power flows through it to pistons and other components — on a single slab and when doubled into a full block (new in v1.5.97).

---

## 🧰 Crafting Recipes

| Item | Recipe |
|---|---|
| Bedrock Pickaxe | 3 Bedrock on top, 2 Sticks below |
| Breeze Rod | Blaze Rod + Phantom Membrane |
| Heavy Core | Netherite Ingot surrounded by 4 Obsidian |
| Mace | Heavy Core above a Breeze Rod |
| Wind Charge | 1 Breeze Rod makes 4 |
| Rainbow Ingot | Nether Star + Netherite Ingot + Diamond Block (makes 4) |
| Rainbow Sword / Pickaxe / Axe / Shovel | Crafted from Rainbow Ingots in the standard tool shapes |
| Rainbow Armor | Crafted from Rainbow Ingots in the standard armor shapes |
| Emerald Sword / Pickaxe / Axe / Shovel | Crafted using Emeralds in the standard tool shapes |
| Emerald Armor | Crafted using Emeralds in the standard armor shapes |
| Obsidian Sword / Pickaxe / Axe / Shovel | Crafted using Obsidian in the standard tool shapes |
| Obsidian Armor | Crafted using Obsidian in the standard armor shapes |
| Obsidian Stairs / Slab / Door | Crafted using Obsidian (stairs 4, slabs 6, doors 3) |
| Rainbow Block | 9 Rainbow Ingots |
| Rainbow Slab / Door | Crafted from Rainbow Blocks (slabs 6, doors 3) |
| Gold / Diamond / Emerald / Coal / Redstone Slab | 3 of each block (makes 6) |

---

## 🔧 Fixes & Improvements

- Bedrock now properly drops itself when mined with the Bedrock Pickaxe.
- The Mace no longer performs sword-style sweep attacks.
- Optimized the Wind Charge texture for better loading.
- Refined Emerald Armor textures and models for a cleaner, more polished appearance.
- Removed the unwanted gold-colored top layer from the Emerald Armor textures.
- Rainbow Armor upgraded from a flat texture to a full 3D model, with extra detail pieces and a glossy rainbow finish (v1.5.3).
- Old builds no longer get in the way of new releases.
- **New in v1.5.6:** Density, Breach, Wind Burst and Swift Sneak enchantments are now fully functional — real smash-attack bonus damage, armor piercing, Wind Burst launch chaining, faster sneaking, and enchanted-book chest loot.
- **New in v1.5.704:** True 3D held items with Sodium — items no longer render as flat sprites in hand when Sodium is installed. The fix is built into the mod, so it works automatically with no config changes.
- **New in v1.5.704:** Vanilla-style crisp texture edges on Emerald gear, Rainbow gear, the Wind Charge and the Bedrock Pickaxe, giving their held 3D models clean solid sides.
- **New in v1.5.704:** The Emerald Pickaxe now matches the Emerald Axe and Shovel colors.
- **New in v1.5.704:** Authentic Breeze Rod and Heavy Core textures — both items now use the real Minecraft textures.
- **New in v1.5.82:** Heavy Core is now a placeable block with the Heavy Core texture on all six faces, renders as a real 3D block in hand and inventory like vanilla blocks, and still works in crafting exactly as before.
- **New in v1.5.9:** The Obsidian Set (tools, armor, stairs, slab and door), animated Rainbow Block / Slab / Door, and Gold, Diamond, Emerald, Coal and Redstone Slabs.
- **New in v1.5.9:** Obsidian Armor has its own custom 3D model — jagged helmet crest, swept-back horn spikes, cheek guards, layered chest plating with a gem shard, heavy pauldrons, plated belt and boot cuffs — instead of the standard vanilla armor shape.
- **New in v1.5.97:** The Redstone Slab now supports redstone like a full block — dust placement, dust climbing onto it and power flow through it to pistons work on a single slab and when doubled.
- **New in v1.5.97:** The Obsidian and Rainbow Doors now have proper vanilla-style door item icons in the hotbar and hand that match their placed textures (the Rainbow one animates like the rainbow gear), and the Spear, Mace and Wind Charge custom sounds now play correctly.
- **New in v1.5.97:** Obsidian items are fireproof like the obsidian block, and the Rainbow Block now shows its name instead of a raw translation key.
- **New in v1.5.973:** Mob spear attacks now trigger the target's defensive enchantments, including Thorns, so Zombies, Husks, Piglins and Zombified Piglins take Thorns damage normally.
- **New in v1.5.9:** Fixed a bug where a placed Heavy Core dropped nothing when broken in survival.

---

## 📦 Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.16.5 (Fabric)
- **Requires:** Fabric API and Fabric Loader 0.14.21 (or newer)
- **Works with:** Sodium and Iris (Sodium compatibility for held item rendering is built in since v1.5.704)

---

## 🛠️ Development & Testing

ModernKit's features are tested to ensure they work as intended. However, bugs and unexpected issues can still happen.

If you encounter a bug, experience unexpected behavior, or have suggestions for improvements, please let us know!

## 🐛 Found a Bug?

Your feedback helps make ModernKit better.

**Discord:** `@.porel.`

Feel free to reach out if you encounter any issues or have ideas for future additions.
